system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

In the past, the instability and unpredictability of the Iburi’s kekkei genkai made it impossible to impossible to incorporate any basic shinobi arts into the technique. However, that was then, and this is now. Thanks to a stabilizing cure, generations of Iburi have been able to thrive and utilize the clans new unique fighting style known as the Smoke Style fighting stance.

You can enter the Smoke Style Chakra stance as a bonus action. When you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns. While in this stance, you can benefit from either a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu stance and increase your movement speed by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th levels.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Dancing Cinder. You release small cinders around your feet, which generates a smoky haze around them, propelling your movements. While in this stance variant, you gain the following benefits:

Cinder Bow. You gain access to a special weapon called a Cinder Bow, which is formed entirely of special smoke originating from your bloodline, in a design of your choice. This weapon has the statistics of a Long Bow, with a d12 damage die, deals fire damage, and can use your Hijutsu Flexibility to calculate its attack and damage rolls. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon and can dismiss it at no action cost. Reforming it costs a bonus action.

Once per turn, if your attack with this weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC they gain a rank of Dazzled.

Once per round, you can take an attack of opportunity without spending your reaction.

Creatures provoke attack of opportunities from you when moving within 10 feet of you.

Fume Brawler. You release small cinders around your hands, as you prepare to engage in melee combat. While in this stance variant, you gain the following benefits:

Smoke Chains. You gain access to a special weapon called Smoke Chains, which is formed entirely of special smoke originating from your bloodline, in a design of your choice. This weapon has the statistics of a Whip, with a d10 damage die, deals fire damage, and can use your Hijutsu Flexibility to calculate its attack and damage rolls. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon and can dismiss it at no action cost. Reforming it costs a bonus action.

Once per turn, if your attack with this weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC they gain a rank of Envenomed.

Once per round, you can take the Dash or Disengage actions at no action cost on your turn.

As part of casting a jutsu with the Fire Release keywords or passing a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, you can select one space you can see within 15 feet of you that can hold you, as you transform into a cloud of smoke and swiftly move to that space. Attacks of opportunity against this movement are at disadvantage.
